# simulate.dataset.simulate_simple_dataset { #fmrimod.simulate.dataset.simulate_simple_dataset }

```python
simulate_simple_dataset(ncond, nreps=12, tr=1.5, snr=0.5, hrf=None, seed=None)
```

Simulate a small multi-condition dataset with additive Gaussian noise.

Returns keys mirroring ``fmrireg::simulate_simple_dataset``:
``clean``, ``noisy``, ``noise``, ``onsets``, ``conditions``.
